$comment: The HL7 FHIR Validator and the FHIR packages it loads, pinned by sha256. tools/fhir-validate/fhir_validate.py downloads each to its cache only when absent, verifies the sha256 before every use and refuses on a mismatch or on an entry with no sha256, lays the packages into a fresh package cache and runs the validator with -no-http-access and -tx n/a, so nothing is resolved at run time. A bump is a release at least 14 days old (AGENTS.md).

validator.name: validator_cli.jar
validator.provenance: Release asset of hapifhir/org.hl7.fhir.core tag 7.0.1, fetched 2026-10-23 (Last-Modified 2026-10-08, 15 days old). The tag names commit d8783284409e, the Git# the jar's banner prints.

packages.name: hl7.fhir.r5.core
packages.why: FHIR R5, the fhirVersion of every model in models/fhir.
packages.provenance: npm copy published by grahamegrieve (HL7 FHIR product director) on 2026-03-05; its package.json is the core package of 2023-03-26. packages.fhir.org was not reachable from the session that pinned it.

packages.name: hl7.fhir.xver-extensions
packages.why: Loaded by every validator run (CommonPackages.VER_XVER in 7.0.1).
packages.provenance: npm copy published by grahamegrieve on 2026-03-05. packages.fhir.org was not reachable from the session that pinned it.

packages.name: hl7.terminology.r5
packages.why: Loaded for an R5 run; the version is fixed in ValidationService (withThoVersion("6.2.0")) in 7.0.1.
packages.provenance: NOT PINNED: packages.fhir.org, packages2.fhir.org and packages.simplifier.net were refused by the session's network policy on 2026-10-23, and npm carries only 7.0.1. The validator refuses to run until this is pinned.

packages.name: hl7.fhir.uv.extensions.r5
packages.why: Loaded for an R5 run; the version is fixed in ValidationService (withExtensionsVersion("5.2.0")) in 7.0.1.
packages.provenance: NOT PINNED: as hl7.terminology.r5; npm carries only 5.3.0-ballot-tc1. The validator refuses to run until this is pinned.
